preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
    transformers=[
        (
            "categorical",
            OneHotEncoder(
                handle_unknown="ignore"
            ),
            categorical_columns
        ),
        (
            "numeric",
            StandardScaler(),
            numeric_columns
        )
    ]
)

classifier = RidgeClassifier(
    alpha=10.0,
    class_weight="balanced"
)

model = Pipeline([
    ("preprocess", preprocessor),
    ("classifier", classifier)
])
